cases.question: How many days of earned leave can I carry forward into the next year?
cases.answer: You can carry forward up to 45 days of earned leave into the next year. Any balance above 45 days lapses on 31 December unless leave was refused in writing for business reasons. Source: Handbook, page 18

cases.question: What is the maximum number of consecutive casual leave days I can take?
cases.answer:
The maximum number of consecutive casual leave (CL) days you can take is 3 days. 

Source: Handbook, page 18

cases.question: How long is the standard probation period, and is it different for managers?
cases.answer:
The standard probation period is 90 calendar days from the date of joining. For leadership roles (Manager and above), the probation period is 180 calendar days. 

Source: Handbook, page 12

cases.question: What are the core hours during which I must be available?
cases.answer: The core hours during which you must be available and reachable are from 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM IST. Source: Handbook, page 16

cases.question: Which dates make up the payroll attendance period?
cases.answer:
The payroll attendance period runs from the 21st of one month to the 20th of the following month. 

Source: Handbook, pages 17, 22

cases.question: How many paid holidays does PROITBRIDGE give each year?
cases.answer: PROITBRIDGE observes 12 paid holidays per year: 8 fixed national and state holidays, plus 4 optional (floating) holidays that employees can choose from the declared optional list. Source: Handbook, page 20

cases.question: By when do I have to declare my optional holidays?
cases.answer: You need to declare your 4 optional holidays in the HRMS by 31 January each year. Undeclared optional holidays cannot be claimed retrospectively. Source: Handbook, page 20

cases.question: How long is the notice period if I resign as a confirmed employee?
cases.answer: The notice period for a confirmed employee who resigns is 60 days. Source: Handbook, page 51

cases.question: How soon after my last working day will my full and final settlement be paid?
cases.answer: Your full and final settlement will be completed and paid within 45 days of your last working day, provided clearance is complete. Source: Handbook, pages 52, 55

cases.question: After how many years of service do I become eligible for gratuity?
cases.answer: You become eligible for gratuity after 5 years of continuous service. It is paid within 30 days of separation, with the 5-year condition waived in case of death or permanent disablement. Source: Handbook, pages 54, 25

cases.question: How many weeks of paid maternity leave do I get for my first child?
cases.answer:
For your first child, you are entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave. Up to 8 weeks of this leave may be taken before the expected date of delivery. 

Source: Handbook, page 19

cases.question: How many days of paternity leave are available, and how can it be taken?
cases.answer: Paternity leave is available for 10 working days. It may be taken in up to two blocks within 6 months of the birth or adoption. You need to apply with the birth certificate or adoption order within 30 days. Source: Handbook, page 20

cases.question: Within how many working days must I regularise a missed attendance punch?
cases.answer:
You must regularise any missed attendance punch within 3 working days in the HRMS. Beyond that, unresolved days become Loss of Pay unless your manager raises an exception with HR. 

Source: Handbook, pages 16, 53

cases.question: What is the internet allowance policy for hybrid and remote-first employees?
cases.answer: Hybrid employees receive an internet allowance of ₹1,500 per month, while remote-first employees receive ₹2,500 per month. This allowance is paid with the salary and is taxable as per law. Source: Handbook, page 47

cases.question: What is the minimum internet speed I need for remote or hybrid work?
cases.answer:
The minimum internet speed required for remote or hybrid work is at least 50 Mbps. 

Source: Handbook, page 47

cases.question: How many days a week must hybrid employees be in the office?
cases.answer: Hybrid employees must be in the office 3 days a week, with Tuesday to Thursday as anchor days. Source: Handbook, page 47

cases.question: What is the sum insured under the group medical policy?
cases.answer: The sum insured under the group medical (Mediclaim) policy is ₹ 5,00,000 floater. Source: Handbook, page 25

cases.question: Is there a waiting period for pre-existing conditions under the company medical cover?
cases.answer: No, there is no waiting period for pre-existing conditions under the company medical cover. The group policy covers pre-existing conditions from your date of joining. Source: Handbook, page 54

cases.question: How many free counselling sessions does the Employee Assistance Programme offer each year?
cases.answer: The Employee Assistance Programme offers 6 free confidential counselling sessions per year for you and your family. Source: Handbook, page 26

cases.question: How many days do I have to raise a payroll query after receiving my payslip?
cases.answer: You must raise payroll queries within 30 days of the payslip date through the HRMS ticket system. Source: Handbook, page 24

cases.question: What is the deadline for submitting investment proofs for tax?
cases.answer: The deadline for submitting investment proofs is 15 January each year. Proofs received after this cut-off cannot be adjusted in payroll and you will have to claim the refund yourself when filing your income tax return. Source: Handbook, pages 23, 53

cases.question: How much time do I get to respond to a show-cause notice?
cases.answer: You receive a written notice setting out the specific allegations and the evidence relied on, with at least 7 days to respond in writing. Source: Handbook, page 43

cases.question: Within how many days can I appeal a disciplinary decision, and to whom?
cases.answer: You may appeal a disciplinary decision within 15 days to the Head – People, or to the CEO if the Head – People decided the matter. The appeal decision is final within the Company. Source: Handbook, page 44

cases.question: Can I take leave during my notice period?
cases.answer: Please specify the type of leave you want to take (EL, CL, or SL), the number of days, whether you are currently on probation, and how many working days of advance notice you can give. This will help me validate your leave request during the notice period.

cases.question: What documents do I need to attach to a travel reimbursement claim?
cases.answer:
For a travel reimbursement claim, you need to attach legible scans of every bill above ₹500, boarding passes, hotel folios, and the approved travel request. GST-compliant invoices in the Company's name are required wherever available. 

Source: Handbook, page 46

cases.question: Does PROITBRIDGE offer ESOPs or stock options to employees?
cases.answer:
The handbook context provided does not mention ESOPs or stock options for employees at PROITBRIDGE. Therefore, I cannot confirm if such benefits are offered.

Source: Handbook, pages 26, 35, 39, 41

cases.question: How many days of sabbatical leave can I take?
cases.answer: The handbook does not provide information about sabbatical leave.

cases.question: What relocation allowance do I get if the company transfers me to another city?
cases.answer:
The handbook does not provide information about a relocation allowance for transfers to another city. 

Source: Handbook, pages 45, 47

cases.question: I'm still on probation. Can I take 2 days of earned leave next month? I'll give 10 working days' notice.
cases.answer: You cannot take 2 days of Earned Leave during probation, even with 10 working days' notice. Earned Leave accrues during probation but can only be availed after confirmation. Please use Casual or Sick Leave during probation instead. (Source: Handbook, Chapter 4.5 / Chapter 7.2)

cases.question: I'm a confirmed employee. Can I take 5 days of earned leave if I apply 14 working days in advance?
cases.answer: You cannot take 5 days of Earned Leave with only 14 working days' advance notice. For 4 days or more of EL, the policy requires at least 21 working days' advance application. Please apply accordingly. Source: Handbook, Chapter 7.2.

cases.question: I'm confirmed and want 2 days of earned leave. I'll give 7 working days' notice. Is that allowed?
cases.answer: Your request for 2 days of earned leave with 7 working days' notice is allowed as per policy (Chapter 7).

cases.question: Can I take 4 days of casual leave in a row?
cases.answer: You cannot take 4 days of casual leave in a row because the policy allows a maximum of 3 consecutive days for casual leave. Please plan your leave accordingly. Source: Handbook, Chapter 7.3.

cases.question: I'm on probation. Can I take 2 days of casual leave starting tomorrow?
cases.answer: You can take 2 days of casual leave during your probation. Your request is valid as per policy Chapter 7.

cases.question: I've been ill and need 3 days of sick leave. Is that allowed, and do I need any paperwork?
cases.answer: You can take 3 days of sick leave, but since it's for 3 consecutive days, you will need to provide a medical certificate from a registered practitioner as per policy Chapter 7.4.

cases.question: I'm confirmed. Can I take half a day of earned leave if I give 10 working days' notice?
cases.answer: Yes, you can take half a day of earned leave with 10 working days' notice. This is valid as per policy Chapter 7.

cases.question: How much earned leave will I have accrued after 8 completed months?
cases.answer: After 8 completed months, you will have accrued 12 days of Earned Leave as per policy Chapter 7.2.

cases.question: I've completed 14 months here. How much earned leave have I accrued in total?
cases.answer: You have accrued a total of 21 days of Earned Leave after completing 14 months, as per policy Chapter 7.2.

cases.question: I joined on 2026-03-02. When does my probation end?
cases.answer: Your probation will end on 2026-05-31, based on the standard 90 calendar days probation period. This is according to policy Chapter 4.5. Let me know if you need details for a managerial position or any other assistance.

cases.question: I'm a manager and I joined on 2026-01-01. When does my probation end?
cases.answer: Your probation ends on 2026-06-30, as managers have a standard probation period of 180 days. This is per policy Chapter 4.5.

cases.question: When does probation end for someone who joined on 2026-08-15?
cases.answer: Your probation will end on 2026-11-13, based on the standard 90 calendar days probation period. This is according to policy Chapter 4.5. Let me know if you need details for a managerial position or any other assistance.

cases.question: Today is 2026-10-10. On which date will my salary be credited this month?
cases.answer:
Your salary will be credited on the last working day of October 2026, before 6:00 PM IST. If the last working day falls on a bank holiday, it will be credited on the preceding working day. 

Source: Handbook, pages 22, 53

cases.question: Is the payroll input window still open on 2026-11-25?
cases.answer: The payroll input window is closed on 2026-11-25 as the cut-off was on 2026-11-20. Inputs will be considered for the next cycle. (Policy reference: Chapter 8.1)

cases.question: I returned from my trip 10 days ago with an approved travel request. Can I claim Rs 3,000 for my bills? I have scanned all of them.
cases.answer: Yes, you can claim Rs 3,000 for your bills as your claim is within the 15-day submission window, has the required approvals, and scanned documents. Your manager will approve it within 3 working days, and Finance will settle it with the next payroll cycle (Policy reference: Chapter 17.4).

cases.question: I came back from a trip 20 days ago and want to claim Rs 2,000. I have the approved travel request and all the bill scans. Can I still claim?
cases.answer: Your claim submitted 20 days after returning falls into a gray area as per the policy. Claims should ideally be submitted within 15 days. Since it's between 16-45 days, it is not explicitly approved or denied by the handbook. Please confirm with HR or Finance for approval. (Policy reference: Chapter 17.4)

cases.question: I returned from a trip 50 days ago. I have the approved travel request and scans for my Rs 4,000 claim. Can I still claim it?
cases.answer: Your reimbursement claim is not valid because it was submitted 50 days after returning, which is beyond the 45-day limit. According to the Travel & Expense Policy, claims older than 45 days require Finance Head approval and may be declined. You can try to get this approval, but please note it might not be accepted. Source: Handbook, page 46.

cases.question: I want to claim Rs 8,000 for a trip that was never approved in advance. I returned 5 days ago and have all my bills.
cases.answer: Your reimbursement claim for Rs 8,000 was rejected because an approved travel request is required before claiming, as per the Travel & Expense Policy (Chapter 17.1 / 17.4). Please raise a travel request in the HRMS and get manager approval first before submitting your claim.

cases.question: What internet allowance do I get on a remote-first role?
cases.answer:
For a remote-first role, you receive an internet allowance of ₹ 2,500 per month, paid with your salary and taxable as per law.

Source: Handbook, page 47

cases.question: Calculate my internet allowance. I work in a hybrid role.
cases.answer: Your internet allowance for a hybrid work model is Rs. 1,500 per month as per policy Chapter 18.3.

cases.question: I'm Grade 3 travelling to a metro city. What is my daily travel allowance?
cases.answer: Your daily travel allowance for Grade 3 in a metro city is Rs. 1600 as per policy Chapter 17.3.

cases.question: I'm Grade 5 on a business trip to Europe. What is my daily allowance?
cases.answer: As a Grade 5 employee on a business trip to Europe, your daily travel allowance is 110 USD according to policy Chapter 17.3.

cases.question: I'm Grade 4 on a business trip to Mumbai and the client is providing lunch. What is my daily allowance?
cases.answer: As a Grade 4 employee on a business trip to Mumbai (a metro) with lunch provided by the client, your daily travel allowance is INR 1466.67 according to policy Chapter 17.3.
